query:
INSERT INTO devices (tenant_id, site_id, device_type, serial_number, status, bound_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'active', NOW())
ON CONFLICT (serial_number) DO UPDATE
SET tenant_id = EXCLUDED.tenant_id, site_id = EXCLUDED.site_id, status = 'active', bound_at = NOW()
RETURNING id, tenant_id, site_id, device_type, serial_number, status, bound_at;

SELECT hubs
query:
SELECT h.id, h.tenant_id, h.site_id, h.serial_number, h.device_type, h.name,
       h.status, h.last_seen, h.created_at,
       COALESCE(ast.state, 'disarmed') AS alarm_state
FROM hubs h
LEFT JOIN alarm_state ast ON ast.hub_id = h.id
WHERE h.tenant_id = $1 AND h.site_id = $2
ORDER BY h.name;
